title: European Central Bank (ECB) Traineeship Programme
description: A paid traineeship at the European Central Bank's headquarters in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, open to nationals of EU member states or an EU acceding country who hold at least a bachelor's degree. Traineeships run 3-6 months initially and can be extended once, up to a total of 12 months, with placements across the ECB's economics, banking supervision, IT, legal, communications, and administrative functions depending on the specific vacancy. Trainees receive a monthly grant (published at EUR 1,170 as a base rate, with some vacancies listing up to EUR 2,120 depending on the role and the trainee's qualifications) plus an accommodation allowance. Vacancies are posted on a rolling basis throughout the year rather than against a single annual deadline -- candidates should monitor the ECB's official careers portal for open traineeship vacancy notices.
visaNote: EU nationals do not need a separate work visa for this German-based traineeship; nationals of acceding countries should confirm their own entry requirements.
